name: Kubfu
description: Kubfu, the Wushu Pokémon. Able to evolve into Urshifu Single Strike Style or Urshifu Rapid Strike Style . A Fighting type.
pokedex_entries: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.
If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
